definitions.explanation: a surface paved with flat stones, often seen in traditional or historic areas

examples.japanese: ⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{参道|さんどう}→参道：11980_sandou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{石畳|いしだたみ}になっている。

examples.japanese: {石畳|いしだたみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ハイヒール→ハイヒール：28427_haihiiru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{歩|ある}き→歩く：00538_aruku⟧にくい。

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{石|いし}→石：02177_ishi⟧ (stone) + ⟦{畳|たたみ}→畳：02224_tatami⟧ (to pile up, layer) → layered stones

USAGE:
{石畳|いしだたみ} is commonly seen at shrines, temples, historic districts, and European-style streets in Japan. It evokes a sense of tradition and history.
